scenes.title: The goals
captions: Evolve the data centre as a building type. Test it on real lots, and say where it works and where it doesn't.
goals: To evolve the data centre as a building type, so it exchanges more with its local context: socially, through public programs that share the building, and systematically, through the heat, power and water it trades with the buildings around it.
To test that on real lots: show where data centres can give back more than digital services, and say plainly where they can't.
